currentCounterevidence: report.ts trialVerdict independently checks recorded observations, recomputes hard assertions and treats missing evidence unknown; hard failure cannot be overridden by semantic pass.
latestGrade selects a unique unsuperseded correction head, competing heads remain unknown by existing test intention.
buildReport keeps analysis-only cases unknown and in the denominator; missing/cache-incomparable cost remains unknown; reports are not generalized quality proofs.
controller exportGrading reuses saved templateRef instead of creating a fresh competing template each export; no ordinary new competing-head trigger established.
overfitHints is explicitly bounded/advisory; false-negative/approximate hint coverage is not a scoring/ranking bug.
Candidate validation rejects unchanged/duplicate bodies, so identical-body preview edge alone is not an ordinary producer defect.
unconfirmedIdeasNotRegistered: Malformed trial repeat indices or supplied forged assertion fields lack an ordinary production origin within this scoped prep.
Adoption, budgets, grants, credentials, native execution and network lifecycle are outside this prep.
limitations: Negative for read scope only. No full-package or full-repository no-bug assertion; earlier source equality is not proof of a current fix or test pass.
